Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Saṅghādisesa 4, entitled *Ukkhittakaosāraṇa* ("Readmitting an ejected nun"), is an ecclesiastical legal text in the Vinaya Piṭaka's analysis of the female monastic disciplinary code. The rule establishes that a nun who, without authorization from the community, reinstates another nun who has been legitimately suspended or ejected commits an offence entailing initial and subsequent meetings of the Saṅgha (*saṅghādisesa*). The Pali text has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali. None of the sampled secondary literature passages specifically treat this rule, representing unrelated matches on section symbols [1–22].
